# muumuu_nameservers (Data Source)

Reads the nameserver settings of a domain.

## Example Usage

```terraform
data "muumuu_nameservers" "example" {
  domain_id = data.muumuu_domain.example.id
}
```

<!-- schema generated by tfplugindocs -->
## Schema

### Required

- `domain_id` (String) The ID of the domain (e.g. `MU00000001`).

### Read-Only

- `nameservers` (List of String) The nameservers without a trailing dot.
- `setup_type` (String) How the nameservers are set up.
